justification: Changes what a paid Intelligence Brief renders to the buyer. One defect suppressed populated data outright: a DataField carrying a real value was skipped whenever its confidence badge read not_available, so permitted uses and similar lists silently vanished from the report. The rest are display corrections on the same served surface — lot dimensions, source-footer labels, overlay classification and staleness wording. No database read or write, no migration, no schema change, no new external call.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any slug in SOURCE_LABELS loses its mapping and humanizeSource falls back to the title-cased slug, so the footer names an internal pipeline instead of the real-world source. Verified by deleting the shadow_detector entry from provenance.ts: the suite went red on that case, 1 failed / 16 passed, and green again on restore.

pre_impl.existing_data: No stored data is touched or rewritten. Every change is at render time over sections already streamed to the page; provenance.ts holds a static slug-to-label map with no persistence, and no property_reports row is read or written by this change.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The prior code assumed confidence == 'not_available' implied there was nothing to show. That is false for fields that carry a populated value alongside a low-confidence badge, which is how permitted uses arrive. The guard now requires the value itself to be empty before skipping.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses main's existing provenance.ts module rather than reintroducing the source-label map into page.tsx. An earlier version of this branch carried its own label map and its own dedupe; main has since extracted both into provenance.ts with case-insensitive dedupe, so only the ten missing slug mappings were carried across.

functions.name: renderDataField value guard
functions.input: a DataField with confidence and value
functions.output: the rendered field when the value is populated, regardless of the confidence badge
functions.if_none: value null or an empty array short-circuits as before, so a genuinely absent field is still skipped rather than rendered blank

functions.name: humanizeSource
functions.input: an internal source slug string emitted by a pipeline section
functions.output: the real-world source name for the footer
functions.if_none: an unmapped slug still falls back to the title-cased slug — the pre-existing behaviour, now covered by an explicit assertion

values.value: df.value on a DataField whose confidence is not_available
values.guard_at: the dfValueEmpty check in the same conditional
each field is typeof-checked before formatting
values.if_missing: renders an em dash rather than a partial or NaN measurement

break_it.scenario: A permitted-uses DataField arrives with a populated array and confidence not_available
break_it.what_happens: Before this change the whole field was skipped and the buyer saw nothing, with no indication data existed
break_it.how: the guard now also requires the value to be null or an empty array before skipping
break_it.repro: Open /reports/intelligence-brief for an address whose Planning section returns permitted uses with confidence not_available; before the fix the Permitted uses row is absent from the rendered page, after it the list renders.

break_it.scenario: lot_dimensions arrives as an object with only some measurements present
break_it.what_happens: A naive formatter would emit NaN or a half-built string such as 'undefined m frontage'
break_it.how: each measurement is typeof-checked individually and only present ones are joined; an empty result renders an em dash
break_it.repro: Open /reports/intelligence-brief for a lot whose cadastre returns frontage_m but no depth_m; the Secondary Dwelling area must read '12.5 m frontage' alone, never 'undefined m depth' or NaN.

break_it.scenario: Two internal slugs name the same real-world source in one run, for example vg_valuation and nsw_valuer_general
break_it.what_happens: The footer would list NSW Valuer General twice, implying two independent sources corroborate a figure that came from one
break_it.how: main's collectSources keys on the lower-cased label so both collapse to one row; a new test asserts the three Valuer General slugs resolve to a single label
break_it.repro: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest --testPathPattern=brief-sources-per-run -t 'three Valuer General slugs'

break_it.scenario: A new pipeline emits a source slug that nobody added to SOURCE_LABELS
break_it.what_happens: The footer prints the title-cased internal slug, exposing an internal pipeline name to the buyer
break_it.how: Not fixed here. The fallback is unchanged and there is no gate that fails on an unmapped slug reaching the footer. Recorded in residual_risk.
break_it.repro: cd frontend-nextjs && node -e "const{humanizeSource}=require('./app/reports/intelligence-brief/provenance.ts');console.log(humanizeSource('brand_new_pipeline'))" — prints 'Brand New Pipeline', the internal slug, with nothing failing.

mutation_analysis: Deleting the shadow_detector mapping from provenance.ts turned the new suite red (1 failed, 16 passed) and restoring it turned it green, so the label assertions are not vacuous. The render guard and the lot_dimensions formatter have NO automated test — both live inline in page.tsx and would need the component extracted to be unit-testable. A mutation that reverted the guard to its original form would still pass the suite.
residual_risk: Two of the six fixes are unverified by any test: the not_available render guard and the lot_dimensions formatting, both inline in page.tsx. An unmapped source slug still renders as its internal name in the footer, with no gate to catch it. These need either a component test or extraction of the render helpers into a pure module, following the pattern main already used for provenance.ts.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — regenerate an Intelligence Brief for an address with permitted uses and confirm the list renders; check the Secondary Dwelling area shows readable frontage and depth rather than a field count; confirm the Data sources footer lists NSW Valuer General once, and that no row reads as an internal slug such as 'Plotdetect Dcp'.
